name: mcp-connector
description: Build-only grouping for this plugin bundle's packages — declares no dependencies of its own. `pnpm run build` (from this directory, or `pnpm --filter mcp-connector run build` from the root) builds every package below in the same host-then-client order the root's own `build` script uses: the client packages import the Typert `/remote` stub that only exists once the host packages' own tsdown pass has generated it.

scripts.build:host: tsc -b mcp-client-oauth connector-registry api-mcp-connector-controller cli-mcp-connector && (cd ../.. && tsdown --filter dsh-plugins-mcp-client-oauth --filter dsh-plugins-mcp-connector-registry --filter dsh-plugins-api-mcp-connector-controller --filter dsh-plugins-cli-mcp-connector)
scripts.build:client: tsc -b client-remotes-mcp-connector client-ui-settings-mcp-connector && for d in client-remotes-mcp-connector client-ui-settings-mcp-connector; do (cd "$d" && tsdown) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm run build:client
